'''Chee Mobok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] textiles [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] that spoke very little [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].

==History==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], Chee Mobok made his living as a textiles merchant despite speaking very little [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="PON" /> The Twi'lek name "Chee" meant, "war, warrior," while the clan name, "Mobok," meant, "authoritative."<ref name="Galactic Campaign Guide">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

{{RPGseed}}
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Mobok visited [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] on a buying expedition. Having initially arranged to meet [[Shep Contopault]] in another city, Mobok arrived in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. Unaware that he was in the wrong city, Mobok blamed Contopault for missing all of their arranged meetings, but was ultimately caught during the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the planet. Mobok attempted to escape Theed by speeder, but crashed it into a pond while attempting to evade a [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAP]] pursuit.<ref name="PON" />

Attempting to escape, panicked and hysterical, Mobok met up with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Sia-Lan Wezz]] and her companions [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]], [[Deel Surool]], [[Arani Korden]], [[Galak]], and [[Dané]]; all of whom were displaced passengers from the [[Crescent (freighter)|''Crescent'']].<ref name="The Official Star Wars Fact File 91">{{FactFile|91|TRA 17-18|The Trade Federation Attack}}</ref> Although initial communication was difficult, Mobok was eventually calmed. He helped the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] group recover his speeder and together they used it to escape Theed.<ref name="PON" />

The group was forced to abandon the damaged speeder in [[Lianorm Swamp/Legends|Lianorm Swamp]]. Mobok followed the group, attempting to return to the ''Crescent'' and the promise of off-world travel. Along the way, Mobok was ambushed and mauled by a [[Veermok/Legends|Veermok]], which the rest of the crew drove off. A [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] patrol led by [[Mokem (Gungan)|Mokem]] halted the refugees and escorted them to the edge of the swamp, refusing to allow them to travel any deeper.<ref name="PON" />

The group eventually arrived at the rendezvous, but found no sign of the ''Crescent''. Instead, they encountered [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|RSF]] [[Security Guard/Legends|Security Guards]] in a shootout with [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] and [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Mobok hid while the crew from the ''Crescent'' intervened, eventually defeating the pirates. The lone RSF survivor, [[Mett Habble/Legends|Mett Habble]], was actually the recent organizer of the [[Naboo Resistance]]. Habble offered the refugees shelter, which Mobak gladly accepted.<ref name="PON" />
